items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know his son Gregory.

ctx.x: Did you know John was sick before he passed?

Yeah. I really don’t like to get into that. But yeah, he was having problems, which I’m sorry about. I feel that so much was at stake. Why endanger that? He should have still been here. If he’d still been here, he would have been 82. He would still have something to say. I know it. Like so many of them that left us so early. Clifford Brown, 25 years old. He would have been close to my age. He would have still had something to say – 75 or 78 or whatever. He would have still had something to say. My goodness. Now…
You look pretty healthy. You feel healthy?
